$schema_note: Machine-readable inventory only. No entry here implies or authorizes migration. S0 (docs/handoff/phase0-s0/seed_data.json, data/canonical/seed_data.json, js/masters-repo.js) remains the sole canonical Master/Drill data authority.

entries.description: 8-week MiLP team training checklist (week focus + checklist items with pass criteria), rendered on the Drill tab and driving the localStorage tracker.
entries.canonical_relationship: none — no 1:1 structural mapping to the 13 Masters / 35 Drills schema exists (different shape: weekly team checklist items vs. Master/Drill progression records)
entries.migration_status: deferred, out of S1 scope; inventoried only

entries.description: Chinese/English shot-terminology glossary rendered as a table on the Learn tab.
entries.canonical_relationship: none — free text reference content, not drill records
entries.migration_status: deferred, out of S1 scope; inventoried only

entries.description: Table-of-contents strings for the handbook, rendered on the Learn tab.
entries.migration_status: deferred, out of S1 scope; inventoried only

entries.description: 10-module weighted KPI dashboard definition (name, weight, target %, current %) used to compute the composite score on the Measure tab.
entries.canonical_relationship: none — module names loosely echo canonical Master themes (Serve, Return, Drive, Drop, Reset, Dink, ...) but the array carries no source_drill_id/master_id linkage and is not schema-compatible with the S0 Master record shape
entries.migration_status: deferred, out of S1 scope; inventoried only

entries.description: Unforced-error-per-game score/state pair (UE_SCORE, UE_PER) feeding the KPI composite score alongside MODULES.
entries.migration_status: deferred, out of S1 scope; inventoried only

entries.description: Six hard-gate thresholds (Serve, Return, Drop, Reset, Shot Selection, UE/game) read against MODULES[].cur to render pass/fail gate indicators on Home and Measure tabs.
entries.canonical_relationship: none — thresholds reference MODULES[] array indices, not canonical master_id/source_drill_id
entries.migration_status: deferred, out of S1 scope; inventoried only

entries.description: PBConfig.load() fetches the V2.3.1 assessment baseline (schema/benchmark/protocol versions, T01-T09 test definitions, lite/standard/full tiers) from data/*.json. Powers the New Assessment flow in js/assessment.js.
entries.canonical_relationship: none — V2.3.1 assessment/test-protocol data is a separate data domain from the S0 Master/Drill taxonomy; no shared identifiers
entries.migration_status: not applicable — separate, already-JSON-driven data domain; no migration implied or needed

entries.description: assessment.js init() requires PBConfig, PBStore, PBMetrics, and PBPreview to be defined before rendering the Assessment Data Core UI; renders an explicit 'modules not ready' message otherwise.
entries.canonical_relationship: none — does not read or reference PBMasters/PBCanonical in any way as of S1
entries.migration_status: deferred, out of S1 scope; inventoried only

entries.symbol: storage.js IndexedDB object stores (players / assessments / test_sessions / trial_events)
entries.description: PBStore's IndexedDB database (pb_v2) storing per-trial assessment evidence, independent of and coexisting with the app.js localStorage tracker state.
entries.canonical_relationship: none — assessment/session/trial records, not Master/Drill definitions
entries.migration_status: deferred, out of S1 scope; inventoried only

entries.description: Legacy per-device localStorage state for the Drill-tab weekly tracker and Measure-tab KPI sliders (STATE.tracker, STATE.kpi.cur, STATE.kpi.ue), keyed by WEEKS/MODULES indices.
entries.canonical_relationship: none — keyed by WEEKS/MODULES array indices, not canonical ids
entries.migration_status: deferred, out of S1 scope; inventoried only
